put.description: Saves a new revision of the endpoint settings and runs validation against `sampleUsername`. The connection becomes `validated` only when the stored report has no issues; otherwise it stays `draft`. On an active connection the new revision is a candidate: the active revision keeps serving until you activate the candidate, and if activation fails the candidate is `rejected` and the active revision stays. Requires an operation signature for action `save`. Use `expectedRevision: 0` when the parent has never had a connection. After a disconnect, send the `revision` of the disconnected connection; the next save starts a new draft.

post.description: Activates a `validated` connection, or promotes the candidate revision that `PUT` saved on an active connection (endpoint replacement). Credential rotation promotes itself, so there is nothing to activate after it. Namespace checks the preconditions, sets the status to `verifying` (the parent starts serving from the endpoint), then resolves the sample username through the ENS Universal Resolver with CCIP-Read. When the live answer matches the validated preview the connection becomes `active`; otherwise it returns to `validated` with `activation.errors`. Requires an operation signature for action `activate`.

get.description: Returns a single-use nonce for a SIWE message. Every Universal Usernames change needs a fresh nonce in its operation signature. The nonce expires after 60 seconds and is consumed when the change is accepted.

info.title: Offchain Subnames API
info.description: API for managing offchain subnames. Provides endpoints for authentication, subname management, and statistics.

tags.name: Universal usernames
tags.description: Connect a .eth name to a username endpoint your brand hosts. Only the current exact owner of the parent can call these routes.

uun-session.name: x-auth-token
uun-session.description: Wallet session for reads: `siwe:<base64(UTF-8 message)>.<base64(UTF-8 signature)>`, the format the Namespace App uses. The SIWE message must be unexpired and signed by the current exact owner of the parent. API keys are rejected.

uun-operation-signature.name: x-auth-token
uun-operation-signature.description: One signature per change, in the same `siwe:<base64(UTF-8 message)>.<base64(UTF-8 signature)>` format. The EIP-4361 message is signed by the current exact owner and has: a `domain` that is the API host or a Namespace App domain; statement `Authorize <action> for Universal Usernames on <parentName>`; the deployment chain ID (1 or 11155111); a nonce from `GET /api/v1/auth/nonce`; an `expirationTime` at most 600 seconds after `issuedAt`; and exactly one resource, `urn:namespace:uun:<parentNode>:<action>:<expectedRevision>`. Actions: `save`, `activate`, `rotate-credential`, `pause`, `resume`, `disconnect`.

label.description: Subname label (e.g., alice if full name is alice.oppunk.eth)

texts.description: Text records to set on the subname

addresses.description: Address records to set on the subname

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata stored offchain or in ENS records

owner.description: Address of the new subname owner (must be a valid Ethereum address)

fullName.description: Full name of the subname (e.g., alice.oppunk.eth)

texts.description: Text records associated with the subname

addresses.description: Address records associated with the subname

ValidationIssueCode.description: Stable issue code. `envelope` codes fail the whole profile, `record` codes fail one record, `transport` codes come from the request itself.

path.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer into the response body. Empty for the root or for transport issues.

message.description: Human-readable explanation. Never contains secrets or the full profile.

username.description: The normalized username that was requested.

requestUrl.description: The URL that was called. Never includes credentials.

issues.description: Every transport, envelope and record issue found.

preview.description: The records that are valid, in human-readable form. `null` when a transport or envelope issue stopped validation.

addresses.description: Keyed by decimal ENS coin type.

onchainConflict.description: Set when the sample username already has an onchain owner. That name keeps resolving onchain and never reaches the endpoint.

hasCredential.description: Whether a bearer credential is stored. The value itself is never returned.

revision.description: Concurrency counter. Send it back as `expectedRevision` with the next change.

activeRevision.description: The revision lookups are served from.

latestRevision.description: The most recently saved revision. Differs from `activeRevision` while a candidate is pending.

source.description: Where ownership comes from: the ENS registry, the NameWrapper, or the ENSv2 registry.

supported.description: `true` for a normalized, unexpired .eth name directly below .eth.

source.description: Where ownership comes from: the ENS registry, the NameWrapper, or the ENSv2 registry.

route.description: The HybridResolverV2 route for the parent. `null` id when the resolver is not HybridResolverV2.

canSetResolver.description: `false` when the name is wrapped with CANNOT_SET_RESOLVER burned.

blockers.description: Reasons the parent cannot be connected as it is, such as `L2_ROUTE`, `CANNOT_SET_RESOLVER`, `EXPIRED` or `NOT_ETH_2LD`.

details.description: Present on `PRECONDITION_FAILED`: one entry per failed precondition.

endpointUrl.description: HTTPS base URL with no query string, fragment or credentials, at most 2048 characters. The username is appended as one path segment.

credential.description: Bearer token Namespace sends as `Authorization: Bearer <credential>`. Required when `authMode` is `bearer`.

username.description: A username that exists in your system.

credential.description: New bearer token. Omit with `keepCredential: true` to reuse the stored one.

keepCredential.description: Reuse the credential stored on the latest revision.

sampleUsername.description: A username that exists in your system. Validation and activation check it.

acknowledgeStoredSubnames.description: Required when the parent has stored offchain subnames. They stop resolving while the parent is connected. Recorded in the events.

expectedRevision.description: The current `revision`, including after a disconnect, or `0` when the parent has never had a connection.
